definition_text: Elements with non-null bounding box (width > 0 AND height > 0) AND (role is one of: button, link, textbox, checkbox, radio, combobox, listbox, menuitem, tab, slider, spinbutton, searchbox, switch OR has onclick/onsubmit handler OR is within a form element OR has aria-label or aria-describedby with non-empty text)
source_reason: Forensic analysis of Method1 150-element estimate was inconclusive - the estimate is a pre-computed heuristic input, not an output of any element-counting algorithm. Cannot trace to specific DOM/accessibility tree traversal method.

implementation.form_membership: element is a descendant of <form> or has role='form'
implementation.aria_attributes: element has aria-label or aria-describedby with non-empty text value
implementation.event_handlers: element has onclick or onsubmit attribute (detected via accessibility tree properties)
implementation.bounding_box: element has non-null bounding box with width > 0 AND height > 0

viewport_definition.description: Elements whose bounding box intersects the viewport rect (0, 0, 1280, 720) with intersection ratio > 0.5
